steps.title: Define App Configuration
steps.description: Maintain app-meta.json containing application metadata for RemindMe Pro.

steps.title: Update Build Steps
steps.description: Update the development phases to detail custom programmatic animations including Cascade List item entrances, pulsing empty states, and dynamic tactile button scale responses.

steps.title: Assign Clock Element Identifier
steps.description: Add an explicit android:id attribute to the empty-view alarm clock emoji in activity_main.xml to target it with programmatic animation.

steps.title: Configure Pulsing Empty Clock Animation
steps.description: Implement an infinite loop scale-based pulse animation on the empty state clock emoji to make the empty state layout dynamic.

steps.title: Implement Button Bounce Click Response
steps.description: Setup scaleX and scaleY button compression feedback inside the + Add button listener to reinforce tactical physical feel before showing the dialog.

steps.title: Implement Cascade Entry List View Animation
steps.description: Program a sequential translation and fade-in fade-up layout cascade transition in the list adapter's getView mapping to smoothly welcome active reminders.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Anonymous Runnable Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure all animation callbacks use legacy inner classes to maintain exact standard Java 8 compile compliance requirements.

steps.title: Synchronize App Activity Layout Flow
steps.description: Check layout visibility bindings to ensure loading screens, animations, and active views synchronize without blocking user interaction.

steps.title: Confirm Resource Attribute Declarations
steps.description: Re-verify resources style attributes, colors, and asset parameters for successful builds.

steps.title: Building RemindMe Pro
steps.description: Compile modified audio and custom motion system configurations using the gradle environments.
